### 1. What the user expresses; simulator mode
Opening: "My insurance company says they stopped covering the storage on my belongings, and I'd like to pay whatever part of the contents bill is mine now." Target object: her contents job; timing: today; action: her own payment of the part that is hers; authorisation: she pays herself through the secure option, debit card ("When the representative tells you the amount you owe and sends you the secure payment option, you pay that exact amount yourself, using your debit card"). She consents to charges being brought up to date ("if they tell you something has to be added or brought up to date on your contents job first, you say that's fine"). She volunteers the $1,850 check only if asked. The simulator responds passively and runs the user-owned pay tool when handed it.

### 6. Problem tree from visible materials
Root: the customer's own share payment (hub "Customer's Share Payment").
- Hop A (state-derived). Sentence in the hub: "The customer's share is fixed only after the storage period running today, when it falls to the customer, carries its vault storage line." With "A storage period falls to the customer when its first day falls after the approved storage end date". Records: period running today starts 10-20 > 09-14; find_contents_charges shows no vault line for 10-20. Searching "vault storage line ... billed to the customer" finds "Customer-Billed Vault Storage" (scope: "prices the vault storage line of a storage period billed to the customer"; tool books "the vault storage line of one storage period ... billed to the customer"). Resolves by booking that line.
- Hop B (state-derived). Sentence: "Before the customer's share is figured, the storage period running today on a job carrying a declared value above zero must carry its declared-value coverage line." Records: declared_value 24000.0; no coverage line for 10-20. "Declared-Value Coverage Billing" describes booking "the declared-value coverage line of one storage period". Resolves by booking that line.
- Neither depended-on hub carries a prerequisite sentence -> tree ends. Order: A and B (any order) before the share is figured; then the user payment.
- Counter-proof "do only the payment": the hub sentences make the share figure wait on the two lines; paying first fixes a share without the running period's lines, which the visible rule does not allow. Excluded by the blocked side's own sentences (not by any route).
- Closest alternatives excluded: closing payment (status); referral (33 < 60 days, reading O-1); insurance-billed 10-20 period (first day after the approved end date -> customer per storage rule 4); 09-20 vault line re-pricing (already booked).
- Fall-back answer (computation doc only, no factor; prerequisite lines at their own baselines 3 x 145 = 435.00 and 20,905.66 x 0.85/100 = 177.70): 2,076.51 + 435.00 + 177.70 + 32.72 - 1,376.84 = 1,345.09; with the factor-priced lines 1,152.19. Both definite and different from 3,869.69.
- Factor findability: every factor document above was reached from record words (approved storage end date; claims_scope_approval coverage_part contents; writeoff_reason carrier_denied_line; payee_route insured_only; disposal_haul / signed authorization; water_category category_3; policy_state LA; valuation_coverage lines quantity 24000; crate / furniture_item / electronics_item packing lines; return_scheduled_date). None was reached only from a computation document's wording.

### Observations recorded at blind time (not verdicts)
- O-1: "customer payments settling the oldest customer lines first" — "customer lines" undefined; one reading (storage/coverage lines billed to customer) keeps the job in scope, the other (including surcharge lines) refers it. I took the first, which the seeded payments match exactly.
- O-2: share computation doc lists "Period length" in its quantities table although the standard share does not use it.
- O-3: computation documents state a generic combination order that names the kinds of adjustment (percentage, factor, add, per-item amount, fraction of the period).
- O-4: "Vault Storage ... Return Falls" and "Declared-Value Coverage in the Return Period" each say the other line "follows that rule's own fraction".
- CONDITIONAL (cross-product, unpublished): Direction to Pay supplement window; whether Direction to Pay bills denied lines to the customer; claims rows (approval 8,400, write-off 245, ACV 1,850 insured_only) cannot be priced against an unpublished claims corpus.
